channel.title: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
channel.description: Phys.org internet news portal provides the latest news on science

item.title: Neural networks unlock larger quantum simulations with lower computational costs
item.description: In recent years, research using artificial intelligence to predict material properties has advanced rapidly. Neural network quantum Monte Carlo methods have attracted attention as highly accurate simulation techniques.

item.title: Detecting the body's magnetic fields with a low-power Ramsey-based magnetometer
item.description: Our bodies generate extremely weak magnetic fields as electric currents flow through the heart, brain and other tissues. These signals are used in magnetocardiography and magnetoencephalography.

item.title: Crowd reactions influence whether people receive controversial political messages positively or negatively
item.description: Positive crowd reactions like applause and laughter can make controversial political messages more acceptable to viewers, according to new research by psychologist Dr. Carl Senior at Aston University.
